## Data flow

Raw study records → paired transfers, friendship, ranks and gaps → null-model filter → saved main analysis data → models, tables and figures. The student file adds only the ranks and the standardized attendance needed for Figure 1D. [Data and measures](01_data_and_measures.qmd) gives the complete filter procedure and dictionary.

## Reproduce the main results

Run this command from the repository root after installing the R dependencies listed in the repository README. The `main` argument selects Table 1, Figures 1D–3, and the numbers reported in the main text.

```sh
Rscript code/run_all.R main
```

The main scripts write the analysis datasets to `data/generated/main/`, the tables to `output/tables/`, and the figures to `output/figures/`. The formatted Table 1 is `output/tables/table1_display.csv`.

In Jupyter, **Data and measures** builds the shared analysis data from the raw records and saves the two completed tables at the end. Every result notebook checks for those data on entry, so it can be run independently. The Figure 3 pages create their own exchange-cell, child-level, and rank-interval summaries after loading the shared data. Each result page offers a Jupyter download; the website sidebar, page contents, and previous/next navigation provide additional ways to browse. For supplementary analyses, see the [Supporting Information index](../si/index.qmd).
